sections.title: Going Second: Choose Your Bonus
changes: The second player now chooses an opening bonus before mulligan in ranked matches against players or AI.
Coin: Start with four cards. After mulligan, receive a 0-mana Coin that grants one extra mana for the turn you play it. You can save it for a later turn.
Extra Card: Start with five cards total.
Recruit: Start with four cards and a 1/1 Recruit on your battlefield. It cannot attack on your first turn, but can attack on your second.
The Coin cannot be exchanged during mulligan. Its mana bonus expires at the end of the turn.

sections.title: Deck Builder Redesign
changes: Updated the saved-deck hub, faction selection, and editor to match the main menu.
Larger collection cards with search and faction, card type, and mana filters.
A deck sidebar showing copy counts, deck readiness, and a live mana curve.
Card and keyword previews remain available when your deck is full.
Improved keyboard controls and clearer feedback for invalid deck names.
Renaming a saved deck saves a new copy, preserving the original.

sections.title: Shop
changes: The shop is disabled.

sections.title: Balance Changes — Gundari
changes: Duster: Stats increased from 1/2 → 2/3.
Sweeper: Stats increased from 2/1 → 3/2.
Scrap Rummager: Stats increased from 1/2 → 1/3. Retains Rush.
Morph Drones: Gains Rush, allowing it to attack the enemy player immediately and activate Headshot.
Carbon Mesh: Now gives all friendly Mechs Shielded 2, instead of giving one friendly Mech Shielded 3. Lasts until the end of your opponent’s next turn and requires a friendly Mech.
Panic Button: Mana cost reduced from 2 → 1.
Junior Pilot: Mana cost reduced from 2 → 1.
Nanotech: Mana cost reduced from 3 → 2.

sections.title: Balance Changes — Sapiens
changes: Lone Operative: Stats increased from 1/1 → 2/1. Retains Ambush.
Kevlar: Now grants +0/+4, increased from +0/+3.
Supply Drop: Mana cost reduced from 3 → 2. Now grants +3/+0, replacing +2/+2.
Requisitioner: Stats increased from 2/5 → 3/5. Its on-play health bonus is unchanged.

sections.title: Balance Changes — Mokotai
changes: Snow Bank: Mana cost reduced from 3 → 2.
Icewhip: Now gives a friendly Yeti +2/+2 before making it Challenge. The buff no longer depends on winning.
Ambusher Yeti: Renamed from the 4-mana Serene Yeti. Stats increased from 2/4 → 3/4. Retains Ambush. The 8-mana Serene Yeti is unchanged.

sections.title: Balance Changes — Junklings
changes: StinkPile, Lord of Garbage: Mana cost reduced from 9 → 8. Attack reduced from 7 → 6. On-play Rummage reduced from 3 → 2.
Rust Grenade: Its Rummage now selects a non-legendary creature.
Decaying Junkling: On play, now deals 1 damage to all creatures, including itself, replacing 2 damage to enemy creatures only.

sections.title: Balance Changes — Generic
changes: Twin Fang: Stats reduced from 3/2 → 2/2. Retains Dualstrike.

sections.title: New Cards
changes: New keyword — Headshot: After a creature directly attacks the enemy player, its Headshot effect activates. Attacking a creature does not activate Headshot.
New Green card — The Staller Mk3: 6 mana, 1/11, Legendary. Guardian.
New Green card — Beam Rifle Soldier: 4 mana, 2/2, Uncommon. Headshot: Deal 1 damage to a minion.
New Black card — Splinterkin Behemoth: 7 mana, 5/7, Epic. Headshot: Rummage.
New Black card — Scrap Courier: 7 mana, 6/6, Epic. When this creature takes damage, Rummage, including when the damage kills it.
New Black card — Rust Grenade: 9 mana Stratagem, Uncommon. Destroy all minions, then Rummage a creature and put it on the battlefield.
New Black card — Lord Knucklepunch: 4 mana, 7/1, Legendary. Ambush. Headshot: Shuffle this creature into its owner's library.
New Black card — Splinterkin Runt: 2 mana, 1/1, Common. On play: If you have more than 10 cards in your graveyard, gain +0/+1 permanently.
New Orange card — Morph Drones: 1 mana, 1/1, Uncommon. Headshot: Self-destruct and heal all friendly minions 2.
New Orange card — Morphling Flyer: 3 mana, 1/1, Uncommon. Pilot 3/3. On pilot: Heal the Mech to full.
New Teal card — Pa'tael: 3 mana, 1/1, Legendary. Ethereal. Headshot: Challenge.

sections.title: Balance Changes
changes: Balance — Plated Soldier: 2/4 → 2/3.
Balance — Frontier Medic: 2/3 → 1/3.
Balance — Dump Scummer: 3/5 → 2/4.
Removed Crypt Chapel from the card pool.

sections.title: Bug Fixes
changes: Fixed a bug where Debris Hauler incorrectly had Cloaked.
Fixed Abominus leaving a frozen card on screen and blocking input when it dies during its on-play challenges.
Rummage pickers now show earned stats, discounts, and scaled card text consistently in local and network play.
